purpose: Teach: 結びつく/オーディション/去り/今季/真意/一読/一概に/トレーナー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究と社会のニーズ、結びつくテーマ、選べ、社会貢献、視点を、持て。
lines.en: Ren — find a research theme that bridges what society needs with what you can contribute. Make that your lens.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Lean forward slightly on 'find.' Pause after the dash to let the weight settle. Final sentence delivered with quiet authority — not harsh, but unmissable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で、若手のオーディションのような選考が、ありますよね。
lines.en: Yes. At conferences, there's that kind of audition-like selection process for younger researchers, isn't there.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful beginning — almost talking to himself. Slight questioning lilt at the end, checking that he's understood correctly. A little nervous energy underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 指導教官が、去り行かれた後の、研究室、君が、支える立場だぞ。
lines.en: Your advisor is stepping back. That lab is going to rest on your shoulders now. You know that.
lines.style: Firm and direct, but not unkind. Weight on 'shoulders' — a moment of pause. Not a threat, but an expectation delivered with respect. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。今季の研究、データの分析、深く、進められそうです、成果、出ます。
lines.en: Yes. I think we can really dig into the data analysis this season. The results are coming.
lines.style: Quiet confidence building as he speaks. Opening hesitant, then gathering momentum on 'dig into.' Final phrase delivered with small conviction — still respectful but owning it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の真意、査読者に、しっかり、伝わるよう、書け、独創性、出せ。
lines.en: Make sure the real argument of your paper gets through to the reviewers. Write it. Let your originality show.
lines.style: Deliberate and sparse. Tap on each instruction — 'write' and 'show' both get little emphasis points. No softening. Warm enough that it lands as guidance, not rebuke.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩の論文、一読、させていただきました、参考になりました、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I read one of your senior's papers — it really was helpful, I learned a lot from it.
lines.style: Respectful and genuine. Soft 'yes' at the start. 'Learned a lot' trails slightly smaller, almost bashful. The gratitude is real but careful not to overstate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、一概に、こうあるべき、と、決まったものは、ないぞ、自由に発想しろ。
lines.en: There's no one way research has to look. No rules carved in stone. Think freely. Trust what you discover.
lines.style: Opens with quiet permission — almost conspiratorial. Builds toward 'freely,' which gets a little more breath. Closes with warmth underneath — he's inviting Ren into something larger.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、新しいトレーナー役、僕も、果たしていきたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to step into this new role in the lab — as someone who supports the others, who brings them along.
lines.style: Resolute and quieter. 'Step into' gets gentle clarity. The trailing thought about bringing others along surfaces near the end with slight warmth. Closes with commitment, not performance.
